text: Yes, there's still work left — but the agent's report was accurate, just dressed up. There's **one epic** ([#2858](https://github.com/pablof7z/nostr-multi-platform/issues/2858)), not two. It's called **X-Ray**: a developer diagnostic tool that lets you (or an agent) ask "why is my feed empty / why did this subscription close?" and get a real answer from recorded receipts. The flagship consumer is the Chirp X-Ray pane (chirp#30).
